name: akoma-ntoso
label: Akoma Ntoso (Legal Documents)
description: UN/EU standard for legislative and judicial documents — EU Parliament, UN, national legislatures
short_description: UN/EU standard for legislative and judicial documents — EU Parliament, UN, national legislatures
long_description: Akoma Ntoso (Architecture for Knowledge-Oriented Management of African Normative Texts in an Open Standard) is the OASIS/UN standard for representing legislative and judicial documents in XML. The schema covers the FRBR (Functional Requirements for Bibliographic Records) work/expression hierarchy, document content storage, cross-references between legal texts, and amendment tracking.
when_to_use: Use for legal information systems, legislative drafting tools, parliamentary document management, or legal tech platforms. Used by EU Parliament (EUR-Lex), UN (UNDOC), African Union, and national parliaments in Italy, Norway, Brazil, and Kenya. Required for interoperability with Legislation.gov.uk and EUR-Lex APIs. Essential for legal AI tools parsing statutory texts.

table_notes.an_frbr_work: Abstract legal work identity in the FRBR hierarchy — one row per distinct legislative act regardless of language or version.
table_notes.an_frbr_expression: A specific language/version realisation of an an_frbr_work; multiple expressions can exist per work (e.g. EN and FR versions).
table_notes.an_document: Stores actual document content (XML or plain text) for a given expression; one row per physical rendition of an expression.
table_notes.an_reference: Cross-references from one document to another legal URI, capturing citations, definitions, and repeals within legislative texts.
table_notes.an_amendment: Records the before/after text changes between an amending document and the document it modifies, with effective date.

an_frbr_work.name: id
an_frbr_work.description: Surrogate primary key for the abstract work entity

an_frbr_work.name: uri
an_frbr_work.description: Akoma Ntoso FRBR Work URI uniquely identifying the legislative act (e.g. /akn/ke/act/2010/3)

an_frbr_work.name: title
an_frbr_work.description: Official title of the legislative act or judicial document

an_frbr_work.name: date
an_frbr_work.description: Date of enactment, adoption, or promulgation of the work

an_frbr_work.name: author
an_frbr_work.description: Originating body (e.g. parliament, court, ministry) responsible for the work

an_frbr_work.name: country
an_frbr_work.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the enacting jurisdiction

an_frbr_work.name: jurisdiction
an_frbr_work.description: Subdivision or supranational jurisdiction (e.g. EU, UN, US-CA) when country alone is insufficient

an_frbr_work.name: subject
an_frbr_work.description: Controlled vocabulary subject tags; expected structure: [{"value": "...", "showAs": "..."}] per Akoma Ntoso FRBRsubject

an_frbr_work.name: doc_type
an_frbr_work.description: Akoma Ntoso document type code: act, bill, amendment, debate, judgment, officialGazette, etc.

an_frbr_expression.name: id
an_frbr_expression.description: Surrogate primary key for this language/version expression

an_frbr_expression.name: work_id
an_frbr_expression.description: References the abstract work this expression realises (an_frbr_work.id)

an_frbr_expression.name: uri
an_frbr_expression.description: Akoma Ntoso FRBR Expression URI including language and version (e.g. /akn/ke/act/2010/3/eng@2021-01-01)

an_frbr_expression.name: date
an_frbr_expression.description: Date this expression version came into force or was published

an_frbr_expression.name: lang_code
an_frbr_expression.description: ISO 639-1/639-2 language code of this expression (e.g. eng, fra, swa)

an_frbr_expression.name: author
an_frbr_expression.description: Body or person responsible for producing this expression (may differ from work author)

an_frbr_expression.name: version
an_frbr_expression.description: Version label for this expression (e.g. original, consolidated-2021, amended-by-act-5)

an_frbr_expression.name: status
an_frbr_expression.description: Publication lifecycle status: draft, published, consolidated, repealed, superseded

an_document.name: id
an_document.description: Surrogate primary key for this physical document rendition

an_document.name: expression_id
an_document.description: References the expression this document embodies (an_frbr_expression.id)

an_document.name: content
an_document.description: Plain-text body of the document, used for full-text indexing and search

an_document.name: xml_content
an_document.description: Full Akoma Ntoso XML source; authoritative representation conforming to the OASIS AN schema

an_document.name: format
an_document.description: Content format indicator: xml (Akoma Ntoso), html, pdf, or docx

an_document.name: file_url
an_document.description: External storage URL (S3, GCS, etc.) where the original document file is persisted

an_document.name: created_at
an_document.description: Timestamp when this document row was inserted into the database

an_reference.name: id
an_reference.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the reference record

an_reference.name: target_uri
an_reference.description: Akoma Ntoso or external URI of the referenced legal text, provision, or resource

an_reference.name: reference_type
an_reference.description: Nature of the reference: citation, definition, repeal, amendment, modification, or passiveRef

an_reference.name: source_element
an_reference.description: XPath or element ID within the source XML where this reference originates (e.g. sec_3/para_1)

an_reference.name: context
an_reference.description: Surrounding sentence or phrase providing human-readable context for the reference

an_amendment.name: id
an_amendment.description: Surrogate primary key for the amendment record

an_amendment.name: amending_doc_id
an_amendment.description: Document that introduces the change (the amending act) — references an_document.id

an_amendment.name: amended_doc_id
an_amendment.description: Document being modified by the amendment — references an_document.id

an_amendment.name: amendment_type
an_amendment.description: Type of textual change: insertion, substitution, repeal, renumbering, or suspension

an_amendment.name: effective_date
an_amendment.description: Date from which the amendment takes legal effect in the consolidated text

an_amendment.name: source_element
an_amendment.description: XPath or element ID in the amending document that specifies the change instruction

an_amendment.name: old_text
an_amendment.description: Original text before the amendment (NULL for pure insertions)

an_amendment.name: new_text
an_amendment.description: Replacement or inserted text after the amendment (NULL for repeals)
